question: What boon is obtained after thrice uttering the thigh-grasping hum-hum sound?
premises: The thighs are grasped with the utterance hum hum take.
This sound is repeated three times.
At the end of three repetitions a boon may be obtained.
inference: Completion of the thrice-repeated thigh-grasping utterance yields a boon.
uncertainties: The exact ritual context of grasping the thighs is not specified.
plain_english: After grasping the thighs and uttering the sound 'hum hum, take' three times, one may obtain a boon.
